edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender into _transferFrom by transfer
msg.sender is used as the spender when decrementing _allowances in transferFrom
recoverEth forwards the contract ETH balance to caller-supplied msg.sender
recoverToken transfers arbitrary tokens to msg.sender
authorized modifier on manuallySwap validates msg.sender against authorizations
authorized modifier on setFees validates msg.sender before mutating fee parameters
block.timestamp drives the per-holder transfer lock and max wallet window inside _transferFrom
block.timestamp plus 360 is used as the router swap and liquidity deadlines in swapBack
launchMode depends on launchedTime plus three minutes versus block.timestamp
launch records block.timestamp into launchedTime
_balances is read and written throughout _transferFrom and its fee accounting
_allowances is decremented and read inside transferFrom
inSwap is read as the reentrancy guard in shouldSwapBack
swapEnabled is read to gate swapBack execution
contract token balance is compared against swapThreshold in shouldSwapBack
launchedAt is compared against block.number in launchMode
launchedTime is used in the launchMode time window comparison
launch writes launchedAt with block.number
transfer delegates execution to internal _transferFrom
transferFrom delegates execution to internal _transferFrom after allowance update
_transferFrom branches on the shouldSwapBack predicate
_transferFrom calls swapBack before deducting sender balances, allowing state inconsistency during external calls
_transferFrom calls launch on the first transfer to the pair
_transferFrom calls takeFee when the sender is not fee exempt
_transferFrom evaluates launchMode for wallet caps and transfer locking
_transferFrom evaluates shouldTakeFee to decide fee handling
isFeeExempt mapping is read by shouldTakeFee
manuallySwap lets an authorized account trigger swapBack and its external calls
swapBack makes external router swap and addLiquidityETH calls that hand control to third-party contracts
swapBack pushes ETH to marketing and team fee receivers via external transfer
recoverEth performs a native ETH transfer of the whole contract balance
recoverToken performs an external arbitrary ERC20 transfer call to a caller-supplied token
takeFee queries getTotalFee when computing the fee amount
setFees mutates totalFee and feeDenominator used in takeFee arithmetic, with only a loose require guard
setIsFeeExempt writes the isFeeExempt mapping consulted during transfers
setSwapBackSettings writes swapEnabled which gates swapBack
sender parameter flows through balance math and fee logic in _transferFrom
recipient parameter determines balance credits, wallet cap checks and transfer locking
amount parameter is subtracted from sender balance and used in fee computation
amountReceived local holds the post-fee amount added to the recipient balance
_token parameter is the target of the external transfer in recoverToken
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping decremented in transferFrom
amountToSwap local is the amount passed to the router swap call in swapBack

normalization_plan.reason: sender is a transient input of the internal transfer routine and carries no independent state
recipient is only meaningful inside the transfer routine balance and cap logic
amount is a transient value consumed by the transfer routine arithmetic
amountReceived is a temporary computed inside the transfer routine
_token is a transient argument of the recovery routine external call
spender is a transient argument used only to index the allowance mapping
amountToSwap is a temporary computed and immediately consumed by the router swap call
